description: This file defines a LogWrapper class that implements logging functionality by wrapping Android's native Log utility. It routes log messages and supports linking to other LogNode instances for chained logging.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class implementing LogNode that wraps Android's native Log utility to facilitate logging with chainable nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a given priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable, then forwards to the next node if present.
